# Twist & Thrive Systems

> Twist & Thrive Systems is a one-person practice in Boulder County, Colorado, run by Gina Harrison. It builds booking and client systems, websites, and pricing for small independent businesses: intake forms, booking, automated follow-up, client portals, and service packages. Pricing is fixed per deliverable, never hourly. Every engagement starts with a free 20-minute Discovery Call.

Founder: Gina Harrison. 15+ years in customer experience and operations at Conga, Movable Ink, and Swrve. Certified Dementia Practitioner.
Location: Boulder County, CO. Serves Boulder, Lafayette, Louisville, Denver, and remote clients across the US.
Contact: consultwithatwist@gmail.com. Book a call: https://calendly.com/twistandthrivesystems

## Pricing
- Discovery Call: free, 20 minutes.
- Time Leak Quiz: free 3-minute self-check at https://twistandthrive.com/quiz. Estimates hours and dollars lost to manual work and names the top time leaks. No email needed for results.
- Booking with reminders: $200. Services, prices, and availability set up in a booking tool connected to your calendar, with confirmations and reminders that send themselves.
- Clarity Audit: $450 on its own; included with any of the three offers or a custom build started within 30 days.
- Stop Losing Appointments: from $2,200. Online booking, automatic reminders, deposits or card on file, intake form, rebooking email, and a simple tracker.
- Get Paid What You're Worth: from $1,200. Local price comparison, new package and price structure, client-facing price sheet, and talking points for raising rates.
- Get Found: from $2,000. A website up to 3 pages written in your voice, with booking built in, a link-in-bio page, and search setup.
- Single small builds (intake form, payment link, one page): usually $200 to $450, quoted on the call.
- Outreach and launch planning: on request, from $1,500.
- Custom Builds (portals, apps, dashboards): from $6,500, most between $6,500 and $15,000. 50% to start, 50% on delivery.
- Monthly Access: $750/month. A monthly check-in, fixes when something breaks, and one small build or update each month. Three-month minimum. Larger plans on request.
- Payments over $1,000 can be split into two or three installments.
- Delivery dates are set in each written scope.
